a16z-mariana-minerals:ashbyhq:036f4673-0.description: About Mariana Minerals Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making. Our culture is built on three principles: - Extreme Ownership – We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions. - Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate – We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale. - Share Your Legos – We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions. Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply. The Role The IT Technician will provide onsite technical support at a remote mine site, ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of all technology systems that support mining operations. This role supports endusers, network infrastructure, hardware, software, communication systems, and operational technology (OT) used in the field. The technician will troubleshoot issues, perform maintenance, manage equipment inventory, and work closely with the corporate IT team to maintain compliance with company standards. What You’ll Do Technical Support & Troubleshooting - Provide onsite support for desktops, laptops, tablets, mobile devices, printers, and specialized mining equipment interfaces. - Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network issues in a highdemand, fastpaced environment. - Assist with installation, configuration, and updates of operating systems and applications. - Support minesite users with connectivity issues, authentication, VPN access, and account management. Network & Infrastructure Support - Maintain network equipment including switches, access points, routers, and fiber/copper connections. - Monitor system performance and escalate issues as needed. - Assist with maintaining reliable communication systems, including VoIP, radios, and industrial wireless networks used in mining operations. Operations Technology (OT) Support - Support field equipment such as rugged tablets, PLC interfaces, fleetmanagement hardware, and sensors used for production, dispatch, and safety monitoring. - Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to ensure reliable data flow between equipment and central systems. Equipment Management - Maintain accurate inventories of IT hardware and consumables. - Prepare and deploy new equipment according to company standards. - Perform routine preventive maintenance on devices and communication infrastructure. Compliance, Security & Safety - Follow all minesite safety protocols and participate in safety meetings and training. - Adhere to cybersecurity policies, ensuring secure configuration and proper user practices. - Support implementation of patches, updates, and security controls across all site systems. Documentation & Reporting - Maintain detailed logs of incidents, resolutions, and system performance. - Update configuration records and asset documentation. - Provide regular status updates to IT leadership and site management. Why Join Us? At Mariana Minerals, you’ll be part of a mission-driven team reshaping the way critical minerals are sourced and supplied globally. You’ll have the autonomy to make big decisions, the tools to innovate, and a culture that values ownership, smart automation, and collaboration. Mariana is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

a16z-openrouter:ashbyhq:0c6bbb7f-ea09-45.description: ABOUT OPENROUTER OpenRouter is the leading AI routing and infrastructure layer that enterprises use to access, manage, and optimize the best large language models across providers—without lock-in, capacity constraints, or unnecessary cost. You'll land on either our product teams, working closely with PMs and our designer to ship. We have a small team focused on this surface today, so you'll have room to own pieces of the product end to end. This role is ideal for engineers who love autonomy, value collaboration, and have a track record of shipping software that works. You’ll play a critical role in shaping our product as we scale, helping expand our platform’s features, and delivering exceptional experiences for our users. ABOUT YOU - 4+ years of experience shipping external-facing products as a full-stack or product engineer with strong product taste and judgment. - Proficient in React, TypeScript, Next.js, and JS runtimes. - High agency and a bias toward action; you talk to users, you iterate, you ship. - AI-forward in your workflow. You use coding agents often, found interesting ways to automate your work, and have opinions about what works and what doesn’t - Comfortable in a small, fast-moving environment where boundaries between teams are intentionally fluid. - Strong written communication and a collaborative working style with PMs and designers. BONUS POINTS - Prior experience at fast growing applied AI or product led companies - Experience building product in fast-moving, ambiguous industries. - Existing user of OpenRouter or active side projects in AI tooling. alphapartners-coupang:greenhouse:7957055.description: 회사 소개 쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다. 쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요. 직무 소개 쿠팡 카탈로그 조직의 Taxonomy 팀 소속으로 쿠팡 고객의 상품 검색을 위해 핵심적인 업무를 담당할 전략적, 성과 지향적인 인재분들을 모집합니다. 우리 팀은 최신 AI 툴을 활용하며, 카탈로그 및 쿠팡 전사 조직을 지원하여 taxonomy 및 AI 모델과 관련된 고객 인사이트를 도출합니다. 프로덕트, 데이터 사이언스 및 운영 등 다양한 영역 전반에 걸쳐 데이터 기반 taxonomy 최적화를 수행합니다. baincapitalventures-gather-ai:greenhouse.description: About Us Are you ready to build the future of supply chain? At Gather AI, we're not just creating software; we're pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We've developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining "on-time, in full" delivery. If you're looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We're leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time. About You As a Principal Systems Engineer at Gather AI you will be a technical leader, driving the development and integration of cutting-edge autonomous and passive sensing systems, bridging the gap between product vision, complex system requirements, hardware implementation, and real-world performance. What You’ll Do Take full technical ownership of the design, architecture, and integration of the autonomous data gathering systems in logistics and material handling environments. Collaborate with Product Management, Customers, and cross-functional engineering teams (e.g., Software, Hardware, Cloud, Test) to negotiate and finalize system boundaries and interfaces. Serve as a technical leader, mentoring less experienced engineers and setting the standard for systems engineering best practices. Possess specific, in-depth knowledge of hardware implementation and integration challenges for both active robotic components (e.g., actuators, controllers) and passive sensing modalities (e.g., RGB cameras, depth cameras). Drive trade-off analyses, risk assessment, and mitigation planning for critical system elements. Requirements BS, MS, or PhD in Systems Engineering, Robotics, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 10-15 years of experience in systems engineering, with a significant focus on complex hybrid hardware/software systems. Demonstrated technical ownership of major cross-functional product development initiatives. Comfort with complex algorithms in the robotics domain - finding, evaluating, and applying algorithms in mixed language (C++/Python) systems. Understanding of considerations regarding mechanical mounts, power and RF, and ingress protection. Expertise in the integration and performance characterization of passive sensing systems (e.g., perception, localization, mapping) and/or active robotic systems (e.g., navigation, control). Proven track record of defining and verifying system requirements for complex autonomous systems. Strong communication skills, particularly in writing documents that identify critical requirements and explain challenging problems clearly. Persistence and calm leadership in an agile work environment.

bvp-anthropic:greenhouse:4980427008.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role: When you see what modern language models are capable of, do you wonder, "How do these things work? How can we trust them?" The Interpretability team at Anthropic is working to reverse-engineer how trained models work because we believe that a mechanistic understanding is the most robust way to make advanced systems safe. We’re looking for researchers and engineers to join our efforts. People mean many different things by "interpretability". We're focused on mechanistic interpretability, which aims to discover how neural network parameters map to meaningful algorithms. Some useful analogies might be to think of us as trying to do "biology" or "neuroscience" of neural networks using “microscopes” we build, or as treating neural networks as binary computer programs we're trying to "reverse engineer". A few places to learn more about our work and team at a high level are this introduction to Interpretability from our research lead, Chris Olah ; a discussion of our work on the Hard Fork podcast produced by the New York Times, and this blog post (and accompanying video) sharing more about some of the engineering challenges we’d had to solve to get these results. Some of our team's notable publications include A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits , In-context Learning and Induction Heads , Toy Models of Superposition , Scaling Monosemanticity , and our Circuits’ Methods and Biology papers. This work builds on ideas from members' work prior to Anthropic such as the original circuits thread , Multimodal Neurons , Activation Atlases , and Building Blocks . We aim to create a solid foundation for mechanistically understanding neural networks and making them safe (see our vision post ).
